title: RAVENHURST / OUTSIDE
description: The motorcar has stopped beside the open gates. Your coachman waits on the left, by the car. Across the wet drive, the lit front door promises shelter.

hotspots.name: Coachman
hotspots.text: A heavyset man in a rain-dark coat and scally cap. Beneath the coat: burgundy racing silks with gold diamonds, cream breeches and riding boots. Unusual clothes for a motorcar driver.

hotspots.name: Motorcar
hotspots.text: The motorcar that brought you from the village. Rain ticks on its roof; the engine coughs as it cools. Your uncle is waiting inside, according to his letter.

hotspots.name: Ravenhurst plaque
hotspots.text: Dr. Frank Mahler. Private practice. Below the name, someone scratched: THEY ASKED HIM TO STOP.

hotspots.name: Iron gates
hotspots.text: The gates stand open. A path of reflected lamplight leads from the car to the front door. You have not crossed the threshold yet.

hotspots.name: House windows
hotspots.text: Lamplight burns behind the rain-streaked windows. A shadow crosses an upstairs curtain, then disappears.

hotspots.name: FRONT DOOR > Knock / enter
hotspots.text: Follow the drive to the front door. James will answer your knock and check your invitation.

hotspots.name: Front door
hotspots.text: The lit front door stands beyond the rain-soaked drive. ACT on it to knock. James will meet you there.

title: THE ENTRANCE HALL
description: Warm light, cold stone. Somewhere beneath the staircase, machinery keeps time.

hotspots.name: Family portrait
hotspots.text: Frank beside his late wife. His expression is almost hopeful. The paint around her eyes is worn away.

hotspots.name: James
hotspots.text: James's dark coat is carefully brushed. His hands are folded. When he catches your eye, he straightens his cuffs.

hotspots.name: Go outside
hotspots.text: The front doors lead back down the drive to the iron gates and the rain.

title: THE GUEST ROOM
description: Your uncle prepared a room. He did not prepare an explanation. The clock has stopped.

hotspots.name: Grandfather clock
hotspots.text: A hand is missing. Scratched below the dial: VIII / IV. Eight hours, four five-minute marks.

hotspots.name: Bedside letter
hotspots.text: A half-written apology: If the clock opens the way, do not let the house decide who leaves.

hotspots.name: Hall
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Hall.

title: THE LIBRARY
description: Books climb into shadow. A patient is reading the same sentence over and over.

hotspots.name: Elias Hart
hotspots.text: Elias keeps a brass key in his closed hand. He needs to know you have read the records.

hotspots.name: Brass clock hand
hotspots.text: A clock hand has been used as a bookmark. Someone wanted the clock to remain silent.

hotspots.name: Annotated volume
hotspots.text: The margin reads: It let me read again. Then another voice began reading with me. Signed E.H.

title: THE DINING ROOM
description: Six places are laid. No one has eaten. The silver reflects a room that feels too crowded.

hotspots.name: Bent hairpin
hotspots.text: A bent hairpin beside an untouched plate. Thin enough to lift a simple drawer catch.

hotspots.name: Place cards
hotspots.text: Elias. Clara. Thomas. Miriam. Four names in careful handwriting. Two other chairs have no names.

hotspots.name: Hall
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Hall.

title: THE CONSERVATORY
description: Moonlight filters through wet glass. Someone has kept the plants alive despite everything.

hotspots.name: Ada Finch
hotspots.text: The gardener smells of soil and lamp oil. She has seen lights beneath the lake.

hotspots.name: Oil can
hotspots.text: A small can of machine oil. Its label warns that the generator bearings must never run dry.

hotspots.name: Stone basin
hotspots.text: The overflow runs toward the lake. Beneath it, pipes pulse with a sickly sweet vapor.

hotspots.name: Dining

title: MAHLER'S STUDY
description: Private letters. Altered charts. A locked drawer. This was never merely an invitation to observe.

hotspots.name: Locked desk
hotspots.text: The drawer is caught on a spring latch. A thin piece of wire could lift it.

hotspots.name: Three-symbol safe
hotspots.text: Three symbols guard the safe. An inscription reads: Follow the chapel glass from night into dawn.

hotspots.name: Prescription notes
hotspots.text: Preparation R. Early improvement. Later auditory phenomena. The later pages no longer mention permission.

hotspots.name: Library
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Library.

hotspots.name: Attic lab
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Attic lab.

title: THE ATTIC LABORATORY
description: Your uncle is gone. The apparatus still breathes. His final work is not an answer; it is a choice.

hotspots.name: Mixing apparatus
hotspots.text: Three fictional reagents remain: azure, amber, clear. Read the notebook before mixing.

hotspots.name: Laboratory notebook
hotspots.text: A reversal sequence: AZURE, then AMBER, then CLEAR. It binds the vapor in the pipes. Do not give Preparation R to anyone.

hotspots.name: Frank's last letter
hotspots.text: I thought I could hear her. They asked me to stop. I wrote that down, and continued. Do not mistake my grief for an excuse.

hotspots.name: Study
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Study.

title: THE HIDDEN STAIR
description: The clock slides aside. The air below is warmer than it should be, and carries a faint voice.

hotspots.name: Pipe diagram
hotspots.text: Power feeds ventilation. Ventilation feeds the ward. The reservoir carries the outflow. Shut the source before opening the gate.

title: THE LOWER WARD
description: Beds stand behind ironwork. These people are waiting for someone to believe them.

hotspots.name: Clara Vale
hotspots.text: Clara speaks steadily. She wants the names preserved, the vapor stopped, and a safe route out.

hotspots.name: Thomas Reed
hotspots.text: Thomas has watched the pressure gauge through sleepless nights.

hotspots.name: Vapor inlet
hotspots.text: A dosing inlet. The laboratory reversal mixture could bind the remaining vapor.

hotspots.name: Ward gate
hotspots.text: The gate is locked. Clara will not lead anyone out until the records, air and escape route are safe.

title: THE RECORD ARCHIVE
description: Names have been replaced by numbers. You can put them back before this house is emptied.

hotspots.name: Patient register
hotspots.text: Four folders, four missing names. Match them in admission order using Miriam and the brass nameplates.

hotspots.name: Brass nameplates
hotspots.text: Admissions: E.H. on Monday; C.V. on Tuesday; T.R. on Wednesday; M.B. on Thursday.

hotspots.name: Miriam Bell
hotspots.text: Miriam remembers every name. She refuses to leave as Patient Four.

title: THE BOILER ROOM
description: A low mechanical heartbeat. Three controls separate the patients from the source of the vapor.

hotspots.name: Pressure controls
hotspots.text: Three valves: ISOLATE, RETURN, RELEASE. Thomas knows the safe sequence. The powered fan must run first.

hotspots.name: Pressure gauge
hotspots.text: The needle must return to zero before the ward can open. Forcing the release now would spread the vapor.

title: THE ABANDONED CHAPEL
description: A private chapel built for forgiveness. The organ has not been played in years.

hotspots.name: Stained glass
hotspots.text: Three emblems rise toward the light: MOON, STAR, SUN. The same shapes are cut into the study safe.

hotspots.name: Organ keyboard
hotspots.text: The score is marked C - E - G. A brass tuning fork rests behind a resonant latch.

hotspots.name: Library
hotspots.text: The passage leads to Library.

title: THE BOATHOUSE
description: Across the lake lies a road, a village, and people who might listen. The boat is large enough for everyone.

hotspots.name: Coil of rope
hotspots.text: A strong mooring rope. Enough to secure the reservoir crossing.

hotspots.name: Rowboat
hotspots.text: The oars are ready. You will not abandon the people beneath the house.

title: THE GENERATOR
description: Copper coils wait in silence. The motor needs a fuse and oil before it can drive the ventilation fan.

hotspots.name: Fuse cabinet
hotspots.text: The cabinet has an empty fuse socket. The safe in the study held the maintenance supplies.

hotspots.name: Dry motor bearings
hotspots.text: The bearings are dry. Add machine oil before starting this generator.

title: THE RESERVOIR
description: The bridge is damaged and the sluice is locked by a humming metal latch. The lake waits beyond.

hotspots.name: Resonant sluice latch
hotspots.text: A resonant latch, and a broken safety cable. A tuning fork can release it once a rope secures the crossing.

hotspots.name: Bridge anchor
hotspots.text: The bridge needs a new safety line before anyone can cross.
